summary: This study introduces two novel ALD precursors for the deposition of GeO2 thin films on Si(100) substrates. The ALD process was conducted using thermal conditions, and the growth rates were optimized. The films exhibited smooth surfaces and low impurity levels, with potential for industrial applications.
evidence: In conclusion, the two precursors produced good-quality GeO2 thin films via the ALD process. The ALD windows of bis(dimethylamino)(N,N0-di-isopropyl-ethylenediamine) germanium and bis(dimethylamino)(N,N0-di-tert-butylethylene-diamine) germanium were established at 200–330 /C14C with a growth rate of about 0.40 and 0.31 Å/cycle, respectively. ALD-type growth mode was verified by increasing the precursor pulsing time. Growth rate was saturated from 3.0 s. These films have considerable potential for industrial applications.
